description: This file defines threading primitives and classes wrapping SDL threading functionalities, including thread management, mutexes, condition variables, and asynchronous operations.

classes.name: manager
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of threading resources.

classes.name: thread
classes.description: Represents a thread, allowing creation, killing, joining, and detaching.

classes.name: mutex
classes.description: Implements a binary mutex for thread synchronization.

classes.name: lock
classes.description: RAII lock object for mutexes, ensuring mutex is locked/unlocked appropriately.

classes.name: condition
classes.description: Implements condition variables for thread synchronization, waiting, signaling, and broadcasting.

classes.name: waiter
classes.description: Interface for waiting on asynchronous operations.

classes.name: async_operation
classes.description: Represents an asynchronous operation with execution, notification, and abort capabilities.

classes.name: async_operation_holder
classes.description: Manages the lifetime of an async_operation object, ensuring proper deletion.

methods.name: thread
methods.description: Constructor to create a new thread with a function and optional data.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Waits for the thread to finish execution.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the thread, allowing it to run independently.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Constructor that locks the mutex; destructor unlocks it.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits on a condition variable until signaled.

methods.name: wait_timeout
methods.description: Waits on a condition variable with a timeout.

methods.name: notify_one
methods.description: Wakes up one thread waiting on the condition.

methods.name: notify_all
methods.description: Wakes up all threads waiting on the condition.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the asynchronous operation, possibly blocking.

methods.name: notify_finished
methods.description: Signals that the async operation has finished.
